events.title: We’re getting ready for launch!

Come try the demo, check in, and say hi. I’d love to hear how your adventure is going. Behind the scenes, we’re putting the final polishing touches on the game. events.title: The Pre-Release Demo Is Now Playable!
events.summary: The free pre-release demo for Return to Planet Zoveka is now playable on Steam.It is a generous early-to-mid-game slice: herd and merge cosmic dust, expand the family mining operation, unlock upgrades, and start automating. The Dust Rush Challenge Arcade mode is fully playable, too.The demo is still developing, and your input will help guide the road to release. events.title: Celebrating the Artists and Musicians Behind Return to Planet Zoveka
events.summary: Creating the world of Return to Planet Zoveka is a collaborative effort, and we have been fortunate to work with a wonderfully talented group of visual artists and musicians.Bringing a game to life takes far more than ideas and code. Its worlds need atmosphere and identity, its characters need personality, and its music needs to capture the emotion and energy of the experience. events.title: Our Public Demo Is Almost Ready!
events.summary: We’re excited to share that the public demo for Return to Planet Zoveka is progressing well and is almost ready!We’re incredibly proud of what we’re putting together, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.Our current target is to make the public pre-release demo available around during August 2026. As we continue with final polishing and testing, this timing may shift slightly.Watch this space for more updates and news as we get closer. We’re excited to welcome you to Planet Zoveka soon!
